reason: A read-only local DSH security auditing plugin that analyzes configuration, credential metadata, installed plugins, sessions, and network exposure to produce redacted risk reports.

summaries.zh: 以只读方式审计本机 DSH 配置、凭据元数据、已安装插件、会话结构和网络暴露面，并生成脱敏风险报告。
summaries.en: A read-only DSH security auditing plugin that examines local configuration, credential metadata, installed plugins, session structures, and network exposure to produce redacted risk reports.

capabilities: Read local DSH configuration and credential metadata
Inspect installed plugin sources and statically scan for risky capabilities
Read session file metadata and structures within configured path boundaries
Analyze configured network exposure without making network connections
Generate redacted risk and coverage reports
